name: Rahul Sen
quote: Shanti Niketan took me in when I lost my father. The resident tutors bought my first computer book and taught me to dream without fear. Today, I support my mother with pride.

name: Priya Das
quote: The hostel provided me safe shelter, moral support, and sponsored my nursing college tuition. I dedicate my service each day to the loving values Dr. Sen instilled in us.

name: Bikash Roy
quote: The discipline, morning drill, and physical training given by our hostel sports coach made me the officer I am today. Discipline is freedom.

name: Tanushree Karmakar
quote: From struggling in class 6 to qualifying the State Teacher Eligibility Examination, Shanti Niketan's evening study sessions and caring educators changed my destiny forever.

name: Soumik Mondal
quote: I learned electrical repairs in the hostel vocational workshop. Today, I employ 4 youths in my solar installation firm. Shanti Niketan gave me wings.
